While the existing text is accurate, the addition of new text content represents a major difference. (30/40)

The typography (font family, weight, and size) also appears to be highly consistent with the reference. (12/15)
-Overall (20 points): The generated page successfully captures the general branding, color palette, and typography of the reference page. This difference in state leads to the inclusion of several large UI components not found in the original, making it a partial match rather than a direct replication. (12/20)
